title: Trifluoromethyl-substituted 3,5-bis(arylidene)-4-piperidones as potential anti-hepatoma and anti-inflammation agents by inhibiting NF-small ka, CyrillicB activation.
authors: Cong, Wei; Sun, Yue; Sun, Yi-Fan; Yan, Wei-Bin; Zhang, Yu-Long; Gao, Zhong-Fei; Wang, Chun-Hua; Hou, Gui-Ge; Zhang, Jia-Jing
journal: Journal of enzyme inhibition and medicinal chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究三氟甲基取代的BAPs化合物通过抑制NF-κB信号通路发挥抗肝癌和抗炎活性，仅涉及小分子与蛋白的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Some methoxy-, hydroxyl-, pyridyl-, or fluoro-substituted 3,5-bis(arylidene)-4-piperidones (BAPs) could reduce inflammation and promote hepatoma cell apoptosis by inhibiting activation of NF-kappaB, especially after introduction of trifluoromethyl. Herein, a series of trifluoromethyl-substituted BAPs (4-30) were synthesised and the biological activities were evaluated. We successfully found the most potential 16, which contains three trifluoromethyl substituents and exhibits the best anti-tumour and anti-inflammatory activities. Preliminary mechanism research revealed that 16 could promote HepG2 cell apoptosis in a dose-dependent manner by down-regulating the expression of Bcl-2 and up-regulating the expression of Bax, C-caspase-3. Meanwhile, 16 inhibited activation of NF-kappaB by directly inhibiting the phosphorylation of p65 and IkappaBalpha induced by LPS, together with indirectly inhibiting MAPK pathway, thereby exhibiting both anti-hepatoma and anti-inflammatory activities. Molecular docking confirmed that 16 could bind to the active sites of Bcl-2, p65, and p38 reasonably. The above results suggested that 16 has enormous potential to be developed as a multifunctional agent for the clinical treatment of liver cancers and inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 一些甲氧基、羟基、吡啶基或氟取代的3,5-双(亚芳基)-4-哌啶酮（BAPs）可通过抑制NF-kappaB的激活来减轻炎症并促进肝癌细胞凋亡，尤其是在引入三氟甲基后效果更佳。本研究合成了一系列三氟甲基取代的BAPs（4-30），并评估了其生物活性。我们成功发现了最具潜力的化合物16，其含有三个三氟甲基取代基，表现出最佳的抗肿瘤和抗炎活性。初步机制研究表明，16可通过下调Bcl-2表达和上调Bax、C-caspase-3表达，以剂量依赖性方式促进HepG2细胞凋亡。同时，16通过直接抑制LPS诱导的p65和IkappaBalpha磷酸化，以及间接抑制MAPK通路，从而抑制NF-kappaB的激活，展现出抗肝癌和抗炎双重活性。分子对接证实，16能合理结合至Bcl-2、p65和p38的活性位点。上述结果表明，16具有巨大潜力，可开发为临床治疗肝癌和炎症性疾病的多功能药物。
